name: Leonardo AW119 / TH-73 Thrasher
summary: Single-engine sibling of the AW109 built in Philadelphia; used by EMS and police operators and, as the TH-73A Thrasher, as the Navy's primary helicopter trainer.

engines: Single turbine with one exhaust at the rear of the cowling
fuselage: Wide AW109-style cabin with a pointed nose
tail: Small horizontal stabilizer and ventral fin

tellTales: Single-engine light helicopter with four blades on skids
Pointed nose on a wide streamlined cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The AW119 has a single engine and fixed skids; the AW109 is a twin, usually on retractable wheels.
The 407 has a JetRanger-style teardrop cabin and endplate-fin stabilizer; the AW119 has a broader cabin with a pointed nose.
The 206 has two main blades; the AW119 has four.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (A119/AW119) + 130 TH-73A ordered by USN (NAVAIR)
